description: This file defines an interface `ResourceEndpoint` within the OrangeHRM Core API V2, specifying the contract methods for resource operations such as getOne, update, delete, and their associated validation rules. It serves as a blueprint for implementing RESTful API endpoints related to resources.

classes.name: ResourceEndpoint
classes.description: An interface specifying essential methods for resource management in API endpoints, including retrieval, update, deletion, and validation rule methods.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single resource, potentially throwing exceptions if not found, not implemented, or access is forbidden.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a resource, with possible exception throws similar to getOne.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource, with similar exception handling as other methods.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation.
